title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 59
paragraphs: I myself once saw Cadmean characters in the temple of Ismenian Apollo at Thebes of the Boeotians, engraved on certain tripods, and for the most part resembling the Ionic letters. One of these tripods has the inscription:
“Me Amphitryon offered on returning from the Teleboan land.” This inscription would be of an age contemporary with Laius, son of Labdacus, son of Polydorus, son of Cadmus.
